rows.name: Le's Chinese Bar-B-Que
rows.verdict_evidence: The Second Avenue location closed 'temporarily' on July 29, 2024 (Des Moines Register, via AOL). A Register-syndicated piece (bluewaterhealthyliving.com, 'Le's Chinese Bar-B-Que returns to Des Moines with Cantonese dishes') reports that it reopened May 14 (2026, 22 months after the closure) at a new location on Douglas Avenue just off Martin Luther King Jr. Parkway. The new spot is a small space with four tables, and the menu centers on roast duck, roast pig and barbecue chicken, with meals with rice at $11.99-$13.99. Its Facebook page posts whole-duck availability. That matches the 2831 Douglas Ave address in this row.
rows.notes: No website or online ordering menu found; the restaurant posts updates on Facebook only. News coverage gives only a price range ($11.99-$13.99 for meals with rice) and the dish types (roast duck, roast pig, BBQ chicken), not a readable itemized menu, so no items were extracted. The phone number in older articles (515-244-6111) belonged to the closed Second Ave location.

rows.notes: Sushi Do is a national contract food-service operator (chef-on-site sushi bars at universities, hospitals and corporate campuses). Cuisine should be Japanese/sushi, not American. No location menu with items and prices was found: the MU page gives only a description, sushi-do.com shows a generic program catalog with no prices, and its /menu/ returns 404. The 2023 launch article says most sushi items run $7-$12; that is a range, not a menu. An older MU notice said Sushi-Do was 'closed until August 2024', but the 2026 mention suggests it reopened.
